construct: display: flex; flex-direction: column — the main axis turned vertical
why: flex-direction decides which Figma axis every other layout fact means: itemSpacing, primaryAxisAlignItems and counterAxisAlignItems all swap meaning with it, so an error here mis-draws every sibling fact rather than one channel. It was CARRIED on a code citation alone, and the reader recorded it under the contract's field name `direction` — which is ALSO a real CSS property (ltr/rtl), so the wrong spelling was not merely invisible, it collided with a channel the table classifies separately.

canvas.note: layoutMode VERTICAL on the root auto-layout frame
